headline: Anthropic heads toward blockbuster stock market debut
summary: Anthropic, the company behind the Claude chatbot, is heading for a US stock market listing this week expected to be one of the largest debuts in history, a move expected to make its seven founders multi-billionaires.

claims.statement: Anthropic is going public on the US stock market this week in a debut expected to be one of the largest in history.
